title: Intro walkthrough (30m) — propose times + attendee matrix
text:
Intro walkthrough (30m) — propose times + attendee matrix

['From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pathworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro walkthrough (30m) — propose times + attendee matrix

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a short intro walkthrough (30 minutes):

What we heard
- You run a mixed on-prem/cloud inference stack for PathWorks analytics; priority is lowering 99th percentile latency for interactive scoring and simplifying model rollouts.
- Main stakeholders: Data Platform (you), Security/Compliance, and a Product owner who will evaluate UX impact.

Goal for the 30m session
- 20m product walkthrough focused on inference latency controls, routing and a short live Q&A with our sales engineer.
- Confirm success criteria and tech owners for a follow-up deep dive.

Proposed 30-minute slots (all PT):
1) Tue Mar 16 — 10:00–10:30
2) Wed Mar 17 — 14:00–14:30
3) Thu Mar 18 — 08:00–08:30

Suggested attendee matrix (please flag who should be on the call):
- PathWorks: Alex Rivera (Data Platform), + Security lead (recommended)
- Redwood: Vanessa (AM), Marissa Cole (Sales Engineer), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer, technical Q&A)

I attached a one-page discovery recap and a short checklist of what we’ll demo. Can you confirm which slot works and who from PathWorks will join? If none of those times fit, please suggest two windows and I’ll coordinate internally.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: 2027-03-11_discovery-recap.pdf (1 page)
', 'From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pathworks.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@luminahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro walkthrough (30m) — propose times + attendee matrix

Vanessa —

Appreciate the recap. The three slots look reasonable but Wed Mar 17 at 14:00 PT collides with a standing review. Two alternatives from our side:
- Wed Mar 17 — 16:00–16:30 PT
- Fri Mar 19 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Also, can you confirm if the walkthrough will touch on VPC/private deployment options and audit log retention? I’ll bring our security lead (cc’d Priya) if so.

Thanks,
Alex

Thanks Alex — that works. To cover your security questions we’ll include a 5–7 minute section on deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) and audit/logging capabilities. Priya — if you can join, we’ll reserve time for any security/compliance questions at the top of the call.

I confirmed availability with Marissa and Dylan; they can do Wed Mar 17 at 16:00 PT and Fri Mar 19 at 09:00 PT. Can you pick one? If you confirm Wed 17 16:00 PT I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda and meeting notes doc.

Quick agenda (to include in invite):
- 0–5m: Introductions & success criteria
- 5–20m: Walkthrough — latency controls, routing policies, model pinning
- 20–28m: Q&A (security + infra questions)
- 28–30m: Next steps & owners

Calendly link: https://cal.example.com/vanessa/pathworks-30m

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
', 'From: Priya Singh <priya@luminahealth.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro walkthrough (30m) — propose times + attendee matrix

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. I can join Wed Mar 17 at 16:00 PT. Attendees from PathWorks: myself (Security/Compliance), Alex Rivera (Data Platform), and Maya Patel (Product Owner).

Please include any notes on data retention and key management integrations if possible. If you want, Marissa, please add the short checklist/one-pager to the invite (I can review before the call).

Confirmed — Wed Mar 17, 16:00–16:30 PT.

Best,
Priya Singh
Security Lead — PathWorks
priya@pathworks.io
